description: Explicit allowed differences for the Phase 0 Reader-vs-Live render parity harness. Every entry must carry a category and a reason; the harness fails on any unclassified difference. Entries describe the current, measured baseline only - they are not evidence that the underlying token drift should stay.

policy.typography: Same semantic kind should match font family/size/weight/style, line-height, letter-spacing and text decoration. The entries below that relax this are recorded as typography-token-drift for a later Phase 1 slice.
policy.box: padding/border/radius should match exactly unless the allowlist records a host-model reason.
policy.geometry: Glyph and box geometry use a <=1px tolerance; larger deltas require a per-field allowlist entry.
policy.chrome: Markdown source chrome, caret/selection paint, the Live fence padding band and Reader overflow containers are permitted structural differences; they are recorded here rather than silently ignored.
policy.scope: Only non-deferred probes gate the run. table-cell and hr are measured and reported but excluded from the Phase 0 gate (Phase 3 concern).

entries.reason: CodeMirror renders every source line with white-space:break-spaces; Reader HTML uses the CSS default normal. Text wrapping is a host mechanism, not a semantic token.

Reader headings are block boxes with vertical margins; Live headings are inline text spans inside a line box. The Live block spacing lives on the line (paddingTop on .cm-live-h*) rather than on the styled text span.
Reader paragraphs carry .72em vertical margins; CodeMirror paragraphs are lines with no margin. Block spacing is host-managed.
Reader list items are display:list-item with vertical margins; Live list text is an inline span inside a line and the marker is a separate widget.

Phase 1 inline-code slice aligned the chip padding token across Reader and Live, so chip padding, box height and glyph offset now match. The only remaining measured difference is width: Live keeps the two source backticks in layout as visibility:hidden placeholders so entering edit mode can never resize the capsule (2 monospace glyphs = ~15.84px). Reader has no source marks. This reserve is a required host-model difference, not token drift.
Reader external links append the visible ↗ pseudo-element while Live edits only the link label/source. Text paint is aligned; the remaining width is intentional Reader chrome.

Idle Live Preview replaces [[target|label]] with the visible label, while active/selected state exposes editable Markdown source. Semantic link class and underline stay stable; only raw-source width is intentionally larger.
Reader blockquotes use a 3px left border with symmetric padding; Live quotes use an inset box-shadow with paddingLeft only, so the element box and margins are modelled differently.

Reader fenced code is one pre box with padding, radius and a full border; Live builds the card from source lines with a 13px fence padding band and per-line borders. Font family/size/line-height already match; the remaining structure is the Phase 3 code-block slice.

Reader <hr> owns 32px external margins around a 1px rule. Live must keep the equivalent whitespace inside the CodeMirror line box so every pixel maps to a source position; its literal --- source is hidden with zero font metrics. The gated flowBlockHeight, border, width and paint must still match.
